{{Quote|Welcome aboard this Corellian ''Defender''-class Light Corvette. It was custom-built to offer a Jedi both first-rate combat performance and meditation amenities.|C2-N2|<ref name="TOR:IC">{{TORcite|type=other|Republic Mission: "Introducing C2N2"}}</ref>}}
The '''''Defender''-class light corvette''' was produced by the [[Rendili Vehicle Corporation/Legends|Rendili Vehicle Corporation]] for the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Manufactured on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], the ''Defender''-class [[Light corvette/Legends|light corvette]] was modeled after a [[Unidentified consumer model corvette|similar consumer corvette]] that was inspired by the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military's]] [[Thranta-class corvette|''Thranta''-class corvette]], but the ''Defender''-class was modified specifically for use by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] as a mobile operations base and a capable [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] in its own right. The [[Corvette/Legends|corvette]] could be flown by a single [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], and it was equipped with heavy [[Deflector shield/Legends|shielding]], two sets of dual [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]], and [[Missile/Legends|missiles]]. The [[Starship/Legends|ship's]] interior was laid out over two decks, and a secure [[Holocomm/Legends|holoterminal]], transceiver, conference room, and a [[Medical bay/Legends|medbay]] were among the vessel's numerous amenities. The ''Defender''-class saw use by the Jedi throughout the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and the [[Galactic War]] with the Republic, and several of the Order's [[The Barsen'thor|greatest]] [[Hero of Tython|heroes]] flew [[Hero of Tython's Defender-class light corvette|''Defender''-class]] [[The Barsen'thor's Defender-class light corvette|corvettes]] on their adventures across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. At least one corvette survived to the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], when agents of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] stole the vessel and used it on one of their missions.

==Characteristics==
===Physical appearance===
[[File:DefenderSchematics-TOR.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Technical views of a ''Defender''-class light corvette]]
The ''Defender''-class [[Imperial Customs Corvette|light corvette]] was specifically designed<ref name="Holonet" /> by the [[Rendili Vehicle Corporation/Legends|Rendili Vehicle Corporation]]<ref name="Vanguard" /> for use by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], as the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] believed that traditional [[Starship/Legends|vessels]] of the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] were unsuited to use by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] on many of their missions.<ref name="Holonet" /> The Order imagined the new vessel to be a mobile base of operations that was fast, maneuverable, and well-armed.<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> Rendili<ref name="Vanguard" /> based the exterior design of the ''Defender''-class on a [[Unidentified consumer model corvette|consumer model corvette]],<ref name="Holonet" /> which itself was devised after the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy's]] [[Thranta-class corvette|''Thranta''-class corvette]],<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> but the ship underwent considerable upgrades and retrofits that distanced itself from the civilian model.<ref name="Holonet" /> Rendili specifically designed the vessel's [[Color/Legends|color]] scheme of red and white to create a vessel that would inspire fear in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic's]] enemies and instantly announce the presence of a Jedi on battlefields across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

Measuring seventy-nine [[Meter/Legends|meters]] wide and ninety-four meters long, the ''Defender''-class was twenty-nine meters tall when resting on its four landing gear. The frontal [[Hull/Legends|hull]] of the [[Corvette/Legends|corvette]] was curved at an angle that deflected enemy [[Laser/Legends|laser]] fire easily, and two sets of twin [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] were situated at either end of the bow, while the corvette's [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] was located in the center between the ship's main running lights.<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> The main body of the ship was roughly in the shape of a triangular figure-eight, with the rear of the ship<ref name="Holonet" /> sporting two access hatches<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> on either side and the corvette's twin [[Engine/Legends|thrusters]] situated at the end of the vessel.<ref name="Holonet" /> The access hatches were situated on either side of the central chamber,<ref name="Holonet" /> with the [[Sensor array/Legends|sensor array]]<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> and [[Communications array/Legends|communications dish]] located on the exterior of the vessel above the central chamber. The primary [[Entry ramp/Legends|boarding ramp]] was located in the center of the corvette's lower hull and opened out beneath the ship's bridge.<ref name="Holonet" /> The ''Defender''-class corvette was equipped with high-powered [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]] for defense, while the ship's [[Missile launcher/Legends|missile launchers]] allowed it to take on enemy vessels of far greater size and strength.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

===Interior layout===
[[File:Defender_conference_room.png|thumb|right|220px|The central chamber of a ''Defender''-class corvette]]
Intended as a mobile operations center for the members of the Jedi Order, the ''Defender''-class corvette's interior was laid out in two decks. The upper level contained the ship's bridge, the central chamber,<ref name="Holonet" /> a conference room, and living accommodations for the ship's crew as well as a single [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]]. The bridge could be manned by a maximum of five crew members<ref name="Race to the Ruins" /> or a minimum of one,<ref name="Vanguard" /> and the ship's [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] [[Navigation computer/Legends|navicomputer]] was situated in the center of the bridge for easy access and visibility. The conference room and the living chambers were located on either side of the bridge, and the central chamber provided access to the lower level, escape pod, and the other rooms of the upper level. The central chamber was equipped with the ship's primary [[Holocomm/Legends|holocomm]] system, the centerpiece of the spacious room.<ref name="Holonet" /> The second level was laid out in four rooms: a [[Medcenter/Legends|medical bay]], a cargo hold, engine room, and a central access chamber. Each ''Defender''-class corvette also featured a [[Hollis-series steward droid|C2-N2]] [[Service droid/Legends|factotum droid]], which served as the vessel's steward and ensured that the ship remained in good condition.<ref name="Race to the Ruins" />

==Role==
The ''Defender''-class light corvette was intended to serve as a base of operations for Jedi on assignment throughout the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]], and as such the vessel could fill a variety of roles. The starship's amenities and rooms allowed Jedi to carry out important [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomatic]] negotiations between parties on neutral ground, and the ''Defender''-class's powerful weapons and defense systems allowed it to serve as a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]], in which skilled [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] could take on far larger [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

==History==
===Starship of the Jedi===
{{Quote|I already have one of our best starships waiting for you at the spaceport. Your astromech droid is prepping it for takeoff.|General Suthra|<ref name="Race to the Ruins" />}}
[[File:HeroOfTythonDefenderClassLightCorvette-SWTOR.png|thumb|left|180px|The Knight's ''Defender''-class corvette]]
The ''Defender''-class corvette was first developed by the Rendili Vehicle Corporation at the Jedi Order's request during the [[Great Galactic War]], a conflict between the Galactic Republic and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. The prototype,<ref name="Vanguard" /> the [[Vanguard (Defender-class light corvette)|''Vanguard'']],<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> was entering flight-test stage around [[3660 BBY]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], and a [[Unidentified Jedi (Vanguard pilot)|Human Jedi pilot]] was sent to [[Rendili Vehicle Corporation (facility)|Rendili's corporate facility]] to test the vessel when the ship was stolen by the [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Hylo Visz]]. Visz's ship, the ''[[Crimson Fleece]]'', had just been pilfered by [[Gender/Legends|her]] traitorous crew, and the Mirialan managed to sneak aboard the ''Vanguard'' and knock out the Jedi pilot before the [[Human/Legends|Human]] noticed her presence. Visz escaped with the vessel<ref name="Vanguard" /> and continued to use it throughout the rest of the Great Galactic War, leading a [[Hylo Visz's smuggling contingent|contingent]] of smugglers to break the Imperial-sponsored [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Blockade of the Hydian Way|blockade]] of the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|trade route]]<ref name="Timeline 2">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 2: The Mandalorian Blockade is Broken|int=Timeline 2: The Mandalorian Blockade is Broken}}</ref> at the helm of the ''Vanguard''.<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> Despite that setback, the ''Defender''-class corvettes went into production on Corellia by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], which followed the Great Galactic War.<ref name="Race to the Ruins" />

In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Time">Act I of the [[Hero of Tython|Jedi Knight]] storyline in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' takes place in [[3643 BBY]] per the reasoning [[Template:TOR dates|here]].</ref> Republic [[General/Legends|General]] [[Var Suthra]] arranged for a [[Hero of Tython's Defender-class light corvette|''Defender''-class corvette]] to be delivered to [[Docking Bay 74]] of the [[Coruscant Spaceport]] on the Republic's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The ship was a gift to a [[Hero of Tython|Jedi Knight]], the former [[Padawan/Legends|apprentice]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Orgus Din]], for use during the [[Desolator crisis|military crisis]] that had arisen when the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Angral]] declared war on the Republic using stolen [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapons]] in order to avenge the [[Death/Legends|death]] of his son, [[Tarnis (Sith Lord)|Tarnis]], at the hands of that [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]. The Knight and the [[T7-series astromech droid|astromech droid]] [[T7-O1]], accompanied by the Jedi's new Padawan, [[Kira Carsen]], utilized the vessel to travel the galaxy and foil Angral's plans,<ref name="Race to the Ruins" /> and the trio continued to use the ship as the [[Galactic War]] broke out with the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] Empire&mdash;by which time the Knight was known as the Hero of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]].<ref name="Fate of the Jedi">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Fate of the Jedi|the ''Opressor''}}</ref>

[[File:Defender_Flight_Deck.png|thumb|right|190px|Floor plan of a ''Defender''-class corvette's flight deck]]
Around the same time, Jedi Master [[Syo Bakarn]] requested [[The Barsen'thor's Defender-class light corvette|another ''Defender''-class]], which he gave to a [[Jedi Consular]], the [[The Barsen'thor|former student]] of Master [[Yuon Par]], so that the Consular could investigate the recent string of [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-induced [[Dark Plague|plagues of madness]] that had been afflicting Jedi Masters across the galaxy.<ref name="Ancient Secrets">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Consular|Ancient Secrets|Coruscant}}</ref> After the resolution of that crisis, the Consular was made a Jedi Master and given the title of [[Barsen'thor]], or Warden of the Order.<ref name="A Time to Reflect">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Consular|A Time to Reflect|Tython}}</ref> A [[Unidentified Jedi Master (Mugaar)|Jedi Master]] piloted a [[Unidentified Jedi Master's Defender-class light corvette|''Defender''-class corvette]] while leading a Republic border patrol during the Cold War, but the patrol was lured to the remote [[Mugaar system/Legends|Mugaar system]] and [[Battle of Mugaar|destroyed]] there.<ref name="Mugaar">{{TORcite|type=space|Mugaar Ice Field}}</ref>

The Barsen'thor's vessel later became the host of the head representatives of the [[Rift Alliance]], a splinter government that [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Dorian Janarus]] was attempting to convince to rejoin the Republic. The Barsen'thor played host to the Rift Alliance's representatives while aiding their planets as the war with the Empire began anew,<ref name="An Alliance of Opposites">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Consular|An Alliance of Opposites|the ''Fortitude''}}</ref> and later utilized it during a [[Hunt for the Children|hunt]] for the mysterious [[Agent/Legends|agents]] of the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] known as the [[Children of the Emperor]].<ref name="To Serve the King">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Consular|To Serve the King|Waypoint Station Three}}</ref> At the same time, the Hero of Tython and crew utilized their ''Defender''-class corvette on their [[Hunt for the Sith Emperor|mission]] to capture the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]],<ref name="Guided by the Force">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Consular|Guided by the Force|Tatooine}}</ref> though the group's mission later changed to preventing the Emperor's agents from beginning a [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] [[Sith Emperor's ritual|ritual]] that would consume all life in the galaxy.<ref name="An Unthinkable Alliance">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Consular|An Unthinkable Alliance|the Emperor's Fortress}}</ref>

===Legacy===
[[File:Defender-class_light_corvette.jpg|thumb|left|200px|A ''Defender''-class light corvette in flight]]
The Jedi Padawan [[Jaesa Willsaam]] flew a [[Jaesa Willsaam's corvette|model of corvette]] similar to the ''Defender''-class, though her ship was twice as large and featured a far more simplified layout.<ref name="The Plan is Working">{{TORcite|type=class|Sith Warrior|The Plan is Working|Jaesa Willsaam's corvette}}</ref> A little over 2,000 years after the Cold War, the [[Jedi training cruiser/Legends|Jedi training cruiser]] was modeled after the ''Defender''-class light corvette. The training [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] retained most of the earlier corvette's design, though the rear of the ship was replaced by six elongated engine modules, and the cruiser was tan in color.<ref name="Explore: A Test of Strength">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep507|text="A Test of Strength" - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}}</ref>

At least one blue ''Defender''-class corvette, or a ship very similar to one, was still in use by [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. Alliance operatives [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] stole the ship from the planet [[Feddasyr]] after escaping from a group of [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshans]], though they were unaware that a [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] spy working for the Empire had slipped aboard. The ship, which had been modified to the point where its interior was drastically different from a standard ''Defender''-class, was used by the agents to rescue several other operatives as part of their efforts to steal a [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generator]].<ref name="Rebel Heist">[[Rebel Heist 4|''Rebel Heist'' 4]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|It just didn't feel like something you would want to fly around space and shoot stuff up with. So we put a lot of muscle on it. Now it feels a lot bigger than the other ones, even though it's not; but it has some real presence.|Ryan Dening|<ref name="Art">''[[The Art and Making of Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
A starship similar to the ''Defender''-class light corvette first appeared in ''[[Timeline 6: Onslaught of the Sith Empire]]'', the [[January 22|January]] [[2010]] sixth entry in the ''[[Galactic Timeline]]'' series of [[in-universe]] history videos hosted on the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' [[Star Wars video games|video game]]'s [http://www.swtor.com official website], in which two such vessels are shown at the [[Battle of Korriban]] in [[3681 BBY]].<ref name="Timeline">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 6: Onslaught of the Sith Empire|int=Timeline 6: Onslaught of the Sith Empire}}</ref> However, the short story ''[[The Old Republic: Smuggler's Vanguard]]'', released in [[March 25|March]] 2010, established that the ''Defender''-class was not developed until approximately 3660 BBY.<ref name="Vanguard" /> The ship's entry in [[the Holonet]] division of the ''Star Wars: The Old Republic'' website resolved this by establishing that the ''Defender''-class was modeled after a consumer corvette of similar design.<ref name="Holonet" /> The [[2012]] reference guide ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]'' gave additional information on the vessel's features and origins.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

[[File:Defender_concept_art.png|thumb|right|210px|Concept art for the ''Defender''-class]]
''[[The Art and Making of Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' explained the history behind the ship's development, with concept artist [[Diego Almazan]] providing early designs for the ''Defender''-class that were loosely based on the [[Consular-class light cruiser/Legends|''Consular''-class cruiser]] seen in [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']]. Senior concept artist [[Ryan Dening]] expanded on these designs, incorporating details from the [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]], which appeared in [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], and the ''[[Ebon Hawk]]'', the player's vessel in ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'' and its sequel, [[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords|''The Sith Lords'']]. As the ship was intended for the Jedi Consular class, the designer's first concepts portrayed a more innocuous and diplomatic vessel, but these were quickly abandoned in favor of bulking up the ship into a more powerful vessel that was clearly able to hold its own in battle. An initial proposal had the ''Defender''-class corvette painted in white with blue markings, though this was eventually exchanged for a predominantly red color scheme.<ref name="Art" />

The corvette was originally announced as the ''Vanguard''-class in videos on the official site<ref name="Player Ships">{{TORYouTube|dQvTJnthAV8|STAR WARS™: The Old Republic™ - Player Ships in The Old Republic|site_url=info/media/trailers/player-ships-old-republic}}</ref> and in ''Smuggler's Vanguard'',<ref name="Vanguard" /> but the name was changed to the ''Defender''-class in its Holonet entry.<ref name="Holonet" /> ''The Old Republic Encyclopedia'' later resolved this contradiction by establishing the name of the ''Defender''-class prototype that Visz stole as the ''Vanguard''.<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> Three ''Defender''-class light corvettes appear in ''Star Wars: The Old Republic'': the ships of the Jedi Knight and Consular classes,<ref name="Race to the Ruins" /><ref name="Ancient Secrets" /> and a ship belonging to a Jedi Master during an Imperial [[Space warfare/Legends|space combat]] mission.<ref name="Mugaar" /> Jaesa Willsaam, a character in the [[Sith Warrior]] storyline, flies a ship that is visually identical to the ''Defender''-class, but the vessel is far larger than the standard corvette and features a radically different floor plan.<ref name="The Plan is Working" /> Similarly, the [[Rebel Heist 4|fourth issue]] of [[Matt Kindt]]'s ''[[Star Wars: Rebel Heist]]'' [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] miniseries featured a very similar starship that is blue in color, but the interior of the ship varies significantly from the actual ''Defender''-class layout.<ref name="Rebel Heist" />

On [[November 10]], 2012, the [http://starwars.com/explore/the-clone-wars/ep507/#!/media/slideshow trivia guide] for the episode "[[A Test of Strength]]" from the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series revealed that the Jedi training cruiser [[Crucible/Legends|''Crucible'']], which appeared in the episode, was modeled after the ''Defender''-class corvette from ''Star Wars: The Old Republic''.<ref name="Explore: A Test of Strength" /> In summer [[2013]], a LEGO model of the ''Defender''-class corvette was released. The Jedi ''Defender''-class cruiser, as the set is called, includes four minifigures: a [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]] Jedi Consular, a Sith trooper, a Sith Warrior ([[Darth Marr]]), and the Jedi Master [[Kao Cen Darach]], who is simply referred to as a Jedi Knight.<ref name="LEGO">{{Brickipedia|75025 Jedi Defender-class Cruiser|75025 Jedi ''Defender''-class Cruiser}}</ref>
